title: Microsoft Edge: organise and merge PDF files in the built-in PDF reader
summary: The briefing accurately reports the planned PDF editing and merging capability and its January CY2027 target. Independent searches confirmed the stated documentation gaps for the named policy, default, licensing and protection of merged output; the page does not invent configuration steps or licence requirements.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: How organising, extracting or merging treats protected PDFs and preserves protection on output is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Edge PDF merge extract protection sensitivity labels release notes version. Read Edge PDF page and returned Purview sensitivity-label and Edge release-note excerpts. They cover viewing PDFs or Office PDF export, not protection inheritance for this new Edge feature.
